title: The Impact of Annotator Personas on LLM Behavior Across the Perspectivism Spectrum

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM with Muslim versus non-Muslim/Western personas to evaluate differences in subjective annotations of hate speech and offensiveness in the HS-Brexit dataset.
Comparing LLM annotations of Brexit-related tweets when prompted with migrant and foreigner personas versus native English and local UK personas.
Assigning female, male, and non-binary personas to the LLM to measure variations in its annotations of conversational abuse in the ConvAbuse dataset.
Evaluating differences in abuse annotations by prompting the LLM with specific racial and ethnic identities, such as White and Mixed Asian personas.
